test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the triad that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

LJ - HF - DB

WU - SQ - OM
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

LJ - HF - DB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfa3d11f65cb23a06acbc1203f3e1135860bf578d54edb77ee436693cc2c2af6.png] 

And,

WU - SQ - OM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d24f246a482466d747d9d97a7da41fbf9d5536705f7f498a6823d806ef03180.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) ZW - OR - FC 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d9c1dbb7a0b6fbc788267634c916aa98963f64f4bfa248751435cef1135dcd.png] 

Option 2) TR - QS – GI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c83cdd7c6c27a90905fe8a45aba5693bbc5b3f75f64f28b09137b2080135eb41.png] 

Option 3) US - QO - MK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e3fc73d4b0c90a8524f9be9444bdc4f5f561114592b688eb3bc3bc0d9dc79a9.png] 

Option 4) SV - XV - TR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d02462dbd3efd096c6cf63fa748adcf26d1199e25afd0237520f11d9ae77e42.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'US - QO - MK' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
